what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating otolaryngologist (ENT) or neurotologist no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.
Current clinical audiogram with Air- Conduction/Bone- Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discriminati on (SD) (performed within the past 90 days).
Additional tests such as (ECOG, VEMP, MRI with Gadolinium of the cerebellopontine angle [CPA], etc.) performed as clinically indicated.
Copy of Operative report if surgery performed.

rows.evaluation_data: • One (1) month after surgery; or • Three (3) months if treated medically or with observation; and • Showing no further vertiginous attacks and hearing remains within standards. Submit the following for FAA review: 1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating otolaryngologist (ENT) or neurotologist no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam. 2. It must include: • A detailed summary of the history of the condition; • Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); • Physical exam findings; • Results of any testing performed; • Diagnosis; • Assessment and plan prognosis; and • Follow-up. 3. It must specifically include: • If active disease exists. • If in remission, when did remission commence. 4. Current clinical audiogram with Air- Conduction/Bone- Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discriminati on (SD) (performed within the past 90 days). 5. Additional tests such as (ECOG, VEMP, MRI with Gadolinium of the cerebellopontine angle [CPA], etc.) performed as clinically indicated. 6. All Office treatment records. 7. Copy of Operative report if surgery performed. 8. Personal statement (typed) stating: • Number of attacks; • Severity; • Type of symptoms; • Episodes of hearing loss over the last year; • What type of therapy or medication(s) are used for control; and • How did the episode occur? (e.g., childbirth, straining, weightlifting, lightning strike, etc.).

Submit the following for FAA review:

1. A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating otolaryngologist (ENT) or neurotologist no more than 90 days prior to the AME exam.

2. It must include:

• A detailed summary of the history of the condition;

• Current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any);

• Physical exam findings;

• Results of any testing performed;

• Diagnosis;

• Assessment and plan prognosis; and

• Follow-up.

3. It must specifically include:

• If active disease exists.

• If in remission, when did remission commence.

4. Current clinical audiogram with Air- Conduction/Bone- Conduction (AC/BC) and Speech Discriminati on (SD) (performed within the past 90 days).

5. Additional tests such as (ECOG, VEMP, MRI with Gadolinium of the cerebellopontine angle [CPA], etc.) performed as clinically indicated.

6. All Office treatment records.

7. Copy of Operative report if surgery performed.

8. Personal statement (typed) stating:

• Number of attacks;

• Severity;

• Type of symptoms;

• Episodes of hearing loss over the last year;

• What type of therapy or medication(s) are used for control; and

• How did the episode occur? (e.g., childbirth, straining, weightlifting, lightning strike, etc.).
